channel.description: Recent content in Resorts on YumFam

item.title: Changtai Banyue Mountain Hot Spring Hotel — Private-Pool Room for 2 Adults + 2 Kids ¥659 (≈$93)
item.description:
Deal price: 50㎡ hot-spring residence room for 1 night, 2 adults + 2 children — ¥659 (≈$93, was ¥1,398, about 53% off) · Valid Nov 11 – Dec 30, 2026 · Book by 23:59 the day before · No surcharge on Dec 24, 25, 31 or Jan 1

Changtai Banyue Mountain Hot Spring Hotel （长泰半月山温泉酒店） sits in a forested valley where Xiamen, Zhangzhou and Quanzhou meet — about an hour from Xiamen, and a Fujian Top 20 family resort for 2025. The water is the draw: a self-flowing strontium soda spring emerging at 58 °C, mildly alkaline and rich in metasilicic acid (53.8 mg/L). The ¥659 package covers a 50㎡ residence room (king with one 1.8 m bed, or twin with two 1.35 m beds) with its own private soaking pool on the balcony, breakfast for 2 adults + 2 children (one under 1.4 m, one under 1.2 m) served until 12:30, and hot-spring park tickets for all four with unlimited soaks in 50+ pools during your stay. The pools are open 13:00–23:00.

item.title: Yingde Tianyue Kingdom Hotel — Hot Spring + Buffet Stay for 2 Adults + 2 Kids ¥559 (≈$79)
item.description:
Deal price: garden-view room for 1 night, 2 adults + 2 children — ¥559 (≈$79, was ¥1,588, about 65% off) · Valid Nov 13, 2026 – Feb 3, 2027 · No surcharge on weekends or winter holidays · Book by 17:30 on the day of use

Yingde Tianyue Kingdom Hotel （英德天樾王国酒店）, formerly the Hilton DoubleTree, is a castle-style hotel in Yingde, about two hours from Guangzhou — built around karst hot springs and a chocolate-themed kingdom that kids love. The ¥559 package covers a garden-view king or twin room for one night, a buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 2 children (one child under 1.4 m, one under 1.2 m — the first time the free child allowance has been widened to 1.4 m), an oyster-and-beer dinner buffet (all-you-can-eat oysters, free-flow beer), unlimited soaking in the karst hot-spring water world (30+ pools across seven themed zones, plus dry and wet saunas), and the indoor kids’ playground, table tennis and billiards. On Friday and Saturday nights the hotel runs its anniversary programme — a Wa ethnic bonfire party, stage shows and a castle fireworks display at 20:30.

item.title: Beijing Yanqi Lake View Hotel: Lakeside Room + Breakfast for 2 Adults + 1 Child — ¥766 (≈$108)
item.description:
Deal price: premium or deluxe room for 1 night — ¥766 (≈$108, was ¥1,299, about 41% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · No surcharge on New Year’s Day or Spring Festival

China State Construction Yanqi Lake View Hotel （中建雁栖湖景酒店） sits right on Yanqi Lake in Huairou, 60 km from central Beijing — the lake’s north gate is just 300 metres from the hotel, and the autumn colours on the water are the reason to go now. This Double 11 package covers a premium or deluxe king or twin room for one night, breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.4 m), two coffees, and use of the pool, kids’ castle and gym, with free parking and WiFi. A two-night option at ¥1,499 (≈$211, was ¥1,999) can be used as 1 room for 2 nights or 2 rooms for 1 night.

item.title: Zhangzhou Longjia Hot Spring Resort: 8 Hot Spring Visits + 8 Buffet Dinners — ¥1,111 (≈$156)
item.description:
Deal price: 8 hot spring visits + 8 buffet dinners — ¥1,111 (≈$156, was ¥3,088, about 64% off) · Valid Nov 4, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Hot springs daily, buffet dinner Fri–Sun

Longjia Eco Hot Spring Resort （龙佳生态温泉山庄） in Jiaomei, about 25 km from Zhangzhou and an easy drive from Xiamen, is a 200,000㎡ garden-style hot spring resort built in Tang-palace garden style around 40,000㎡ of landscaped hot springs. Zhangzhou is officially rated a “China Hot Spring City”, and Longjia has been the area’s best-known hot spring resort for over 20 years, with 30+ pools across hydrotherapy, herbal-medicine, petal and fish-therapy zones. This Double 11 bundle covers 8 hot spring visits and 8 buffet dinners — about ¥139 per visit-and-dinner pair.

item.title: Maoshan Yihe Peninsula HENTIQUE Resort from ¥499 (≈$69): Lakeside Stay + Hot Spring or Salt Lake Tickets, Valid to Jan 2027
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + Wangyou Valley hot-spring tickets — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥899, about 44% off) · Valid through Jan 31, 2027 · Refundable if unbooked

Maoshan Yihe Peninsula Resort (HENTIQUE) sits on the shore of Maoshan Lake in Jintan, Changzhou — a one-stop family break: lake-view rooms, a petting zoo where kids can feed rabbits and mini pigs, and your pick of Wangyou Valley hot spring, Oriental Salt Lake City, the Maoshan scenic area or Maoshan Forest World, all bundled with breakfast. Book at least a day ahead; check-in 14:00, checkout noon.

item.title: Beijing Badaling Hilton Doubletree from ¥549 (≈$76): Hot Spring, Kids' Park & Wild Duck Lake Tickets, Great Wall Nearby
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night hot-spring & play package — ¥549 (≈$76, was ¥999, about 45% off) · Valid Nov 6, 2026 – Mar 30, 2027 · No weekend surcharge · Refundable if unreserved

Beijing Badaling Hilton Doubletree sits in the centre of Yanqing — Beijing’s “summer capital” — about 20 km from the Badaling Great Wall and close to Longqing Gorge and Wild Duck Lake Wetland Park. It’s a 2021 hotel with 276 rooms; the premium rooms run about 40 m² with a 1.8 m king bed or two 1.35 m twins. This Double-11 deal packs a lot into one night: breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.2 m), hot-spring tickets for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.3 m) at the Shiyuan Yueqin Hot Spring — a roughly 10,000 m² spring centre with 30+ pools — plus kids’ park tickets, a traditional-craft session and 2 adult tickets to Wild Duck Lake Wetland Park. The hotel itself adds a kids’ club, a heated indoor pool and a gym, and a welcome cookie on arrival.

item.title: Longyan Qingshui Tianyi Hot Spring Resort from ¥299 (≈$42): 1 Night + Breakfast & Unlimited Hot Springs for 2, was ¥1,299
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, annex mountain room with private tub — ¥299 (≈$42, was ¥1,299, about 77% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Double-11 flash-sale tiers · Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Qingshui Tianyi Hot Spring Resort sits in the green mountains of Liancheng County, Longyan — about a 3-hour drive from Xiamen, and roughly 15 minutes from the 5A-rated Guan Zhai Mountain scenic area and the Peitian Hakka ancient village. The resort is built around a large semi-open-air hot-spring park themed on Hakka culture, with 50+ pools — lavender, milk bath, fish therapy, herbal soaks — plus a spa house, an outdoor pool and a wave pool. Every room has natural hot-spring water piped in, with its own private soaking tub, so you can bathe without leaving the room.

item.title: Nanjing Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel from ¥499 (≈$69): Garden Hotel Inside Laomendong, Near Confucius Temple
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night Yayun room — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥999, 50% off) · Valid Aug 26 – Dec 30, 2026 · Fri–Sat +¥150/room/night · Refundable if unreserved

Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel is a garden hotel with a story: it restores the Jiezi Garden, the private garden built 300 years ago in Nanjing by Li Yu — the Ming–Qing literati behind the classic painting manual The Mustard Seed Garden Manual of Painting and the essay collection Idle Thoughts. The hotel sits inside the Laomendong scenic area, about 1 km on foot from Confucius Temple and about 620 m from Wudingmen metro station. Outside the gate is the busy old street, full of snacks and shops; inside is a quiet Jiangnan garden of pavilions, ponds and winding stone paths. The garden itself is open to the public by day, but in the early morning and evening it belongs to guests alone — and the hotel has its own passage into it.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel from ¥999 (≈$139): 1 Night + 2-Day Unlimited Park Tickets for 2 Adults, was ¥1,290
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, deluxe room + 2-day unlimited park tickets for 2 adults — ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,290, about 23% off) · Valid Oct 17, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · Double-11 deal · Refundable if unreserved

Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Resort Hotel is the stay-inside-the-park option at Haichang Ocean Park in Lingang, Pudong: you sleep steps from the gates, enter through a dedicated VIP channel, and get two days of unlimited park entry for two adults (family tiers add one child under 1.4 m). The headline tier adds breakfast for two the next morning, free parking and Wi-Fi, and the current Ocean Wonders Festival (魔都海洋万秀节, through Nov 15) — two brand-new haunted houses, a new Arabian-style riverside street, 150 roaming performers, a night-time orca show and a mermaid light show, plus six refreshed big ocean shows and 100,000+ marine animals across the park.

item.title: Tianjin Jingji Shengguang Hot Spring Resort from ¥499 (≈$69): Hot Spring or Kids' Park, 2-Night Deal ¥719
item.description:
Deal price: 1-night family hot-spring package — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥899, about 44% off) · Valid Nov 5, 2026 – Dec 31, 2027 · No weekend surcharge · Refundable if unreserved

Jingji Shengguang Hot Spring Resort is in Jizhou, the green north of Tianjin that Beijingers call their “back garden” — about a 2-hour drive from Beijing, near Mount Pan, the Great Wall and a ski park. The hotel has 267 rooms, including cartoon-themed family rooms; the deluxe rooms are about 50 m² with lake and mountain views and a big bathtub. Its centrepiece is the Changmingyuan Hot Spring, a jungle-style garden spring billed as a “northern Sanya”: 15 indoor pools plus 6 outdoor ones at 39–42 °C, with herbal baths and the local maifanshi (longevity-stone) filtered water. For kids there is a 1,100 m² indoor play park — naughty castle, DIY crafts, sandpit, trampoline, slides and a mini train — plus a 15 × 25 m indoor pool (28 °C for adults, 29 °C for kids) and a 1,000 m² Four Seasons Garden under a glass dome that stays warm through winter.

item.title: Dongguan San Zheng Banshan Hotel from ¥399 (≈$56): Garden Rooms, Buffet Meals & a Jungle Water Slide
item.description:
Deal price: garden room + breakfast + eco-park tickets — ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥999) · 2 adults + 2 children · Valid September 17 – December 31, 2026

San Zheng Banshan sits in the hills of Qiaotou, Dongguan, looking out over gardens and a 300-mu lotus lake — a proper wind-down base about 30 minutes from downtown Dongguan. Every tier covers 2 adults + 2 children (one child under 1.4 m stays free), and the headline ¥399 tier already bundles a garden room, breakfast for the family and two tickets to Qiaotou Eco-Park. Step up to ¥599 and the buffet dinner joins in: salmon and tuna sashimi, sushi, teppanyaki cooked to order (steak, chicken, fish), hotpot and a dessert table.

item.title: Sanya Bay voco Hotel 2-Night Family Stay from ¥1,288 (≈$181): IHG Beachfront on the Coconut Dream Corridor
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in a Superior King/Twin room (balcony) — ¥1,288 (≈$181, was ¥1,788) · Valid October 19, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · Double 11 promotion

The voco Sanya Bay is IHG’s lifestyle brand on the Coconut Dream Corridor — the golden beachfront strip of Sanya Bay. Step out of the hotel and you are about 50 metres from the sand and the sea; the airport is roughly 15 minutes away and the high-speed rail station about 20, and Tianya Haijiao, West Island, Nanshan Temple, Dadonghai and Luhuitou are all easy day trips. The hotel has 233 rooms, each with a smart toilet and Elemis toiletries, and its all-day restaurant serves buffet breakfast and dinner plus Mediterranean, Spanish and Cantonese dishes and local Hainan flavours.

item.title: Shenzhen Apsaras Qixingwan Yacht Hotel from ¥499 (≈$69): Sea-View Room + Breakfast + Kayaking at the Marina
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, 45㎡ deluxe sea-view room (king or twin) — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥1,299) · Breakfast for 2 · 1-hour kayaking for 2 at Qixingwan Yacht Club · Free in-room minibar · Valid September 24 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ weekends at no extra charge, refundable if unreserved · Book by 15:30 the same day

A sailing-themed hotel right on the Qixingwan marina in Dapeng — every one of its 80-plus rooms faces the sea with a viewing balcony, so the “sea-view room” here is not an upgrade lottery. The deal pairs the room with breakfast for two and an hour of kayaking for two at the yacht club, plus a free in-room minibar (drinks and snacks in the fridge), free entry to the Dapeng Geology Museum (closed Mondays) and the Hetang Wetland Park, and marina perks: yacht-harbour photo spots, a canopy campsite check-in point, a photo-ready sailboat and a kids’ sand pit. Free parking and Wi-Fi included.

item.title: Shenzhen MGallery Fashion Town Hotel from ¥699 (≈$97): Themed Family Room + Breakfast + Kirin Cat Kids' Park
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, themed family room — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,299) · Breakfast for 2 · Unlimited Kirin Cat kids’ park play · Valid to December 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 23:59 the day before

Accor’s MGallery hotel in Shenzhen’s Dalang Fashion Town — a new, art-led five-star where the rooms themselves are the attraction for kids. The themed family room is randomly assigned one of five themes (Alice AR Wonderland, Balala Little Demon Fairy, Milk Dragon, Chibi Maruko or Super Wings), so each stay is a surprise. All tiers include breakfast for two and unlimited play at the hotel’s Kirin Cat children’s park, and the 2-night tier adds a greenway hiking energy pack (2 fruit-and-vegetable juices, 2 waters and 2 sandwiches) plus 2 tickets to the Yizhihui Centennial Fashion Museum next door.

item.title: Anji Yunbanjian Wild-Luxury Hotel from ¥528 (≈$73): Bamboo-Forest Room at 800 m, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Night Star family room or Qiyun mountain-view king room — ¥528 (≈$73, was ¥1,299) · Breakfast for 2 · Bamboo stream tracing with gear · Moss terrarium DIY · Bamboo hike · Welcome fruit · First-day minibar · Valid October 22, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · ⏰ no weekend surcharge · Book by 23:00 the same day

Yunbanjian (“half a room in the clouds”) hides in the virgin forest of Longwang Village, Anji — China’s bamboo capital — at 800 m above sea level, among 20,000 mu of mountain forest beside a 500-year-old golden pine. Just 32 rooms sit along the forest stream, built into the hillside so the hotel feels grown out of the bamboo grove rather than placed in it. The headline tier pairs the room with breakfast, bamboo stream tracing (gear included), a moss terrarium DIY, a blessing plaque, an herbal foot-bath pack and a bamboo forest hike — a slow, outdoorsy stay rather than a resort-with-everything one.

item.title: Changtai Shanwai Yueju Villa from ¥289 (≈$40): Two-Bedroom Family Suite + Hot Spring Park Tickets near Xiamen
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Moyun two-bedroom family suite — ¥289 (≈$40, was ¥558) · Breakfast · Unlimited Luyuechuan kids’ park play · 1 adult hot spring park ticket (each adult ticket admits 1 child under 1.2 m free) · Valid October 21 – December 25, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 23:59 the day before

A quiet, Chinese-style villa retreat in Changtai’s Mayangxi eco tourism area, about 42 km from Xiamen island and 2 km from Tianzhu Mountain National Forest Park — close enough for a weekend escape, far enough to feel like one. The resort grounds cover roughly 110,000㎡ of gardens modelled on Suzhou’s Lingering Garden, with pavilions, covered walkways and streams. The headline Moyun suite is 89㎡ with a 1.8 m double bed plus a 1.2 m tatami bed, and the deal bundles breakfast, unlimited play in the Luyuechuan kids’ park, and a hot spring park ticket — plus a ¥10 single-ride go-kart coupon usable multiple times during the stay.

item.title: Haining Yanguan Chaole City Stay from ¥499 (≈$69): Old-Town Inn + Unlimited-Reentry Theme Town + Qiantang Tide-Watching
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, old-town inn room (5 inns to choose from) — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥1,195) · Breakfast for 2 · 2 Chaole City tickets with unlimited re-entry during your stay · 2 Tide-Watching Scenic Park tickets · Heritage craft experience · Immersive “Tide Music” role-play game · Valid November 1, 2026 – January 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 18:00 the day before

Yanguan, on the Qiantang River in Haining, is the town of the famous tidal bore — the “first line tide” written up in the classic essay Watching the Tide — and the birthplace of writers Wang Guowei, Xu Zhimo and Jin Yong. Chaole City is a 3,000-mu theme town rebuilt from the old city, themed around tide-watching and music, run by the same group behind Wuzhen and Yixing Yao Lake Town. Staying guests get unlimited re-entry to the town during their stay, plus a free shuttle, free luggage storage and a welcome snack, and can walk to the Confucius temple school, Wang Guowei’s former home, Jin Yong Academy and the old city wall.

item.title: Qingdao Xinjiang Wyndham Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): City-View Room + Hot Spring Vouchers + 50,000㎡ Pet Garden
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, deluxe city-view room (king or twin) — ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥999) · Breakfast for 2 · 2 hot spring vouchers · 1 pet-feeding voucher · 1 hour of ball sports (tennis, billiards or table tennis) · Indoor + outdoor kids’ parks, gym and pool · Valid November 3 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 19:00 the same day

A family-friendly Wyndham in Qingdao’s Chengyang district with a genuinely unusual perk: a 50,000㎡ European-style garden behind the hotel, complete with fountains, courtyards, ponds and a pet area where kids can feed the animals — the listing’s own pitch is that a walk, a play session and a photo stop are all sorted in one garden. Inside, the deal covers breakfast for two, two vouchers for the neighbouring hot spring (third-party operated, 12 hours per visit), an hour of ball sports (tennis, billiards or table tennis, pick one), the first day’s minibar free, and unlimited use of the indoor and outdoor kids’ parks, gym and pool during your stay.

item.title: Changtai Shanhaiguan Hot-Spring Villa from ¥298 (≈$41): Japanese Villa Room or Private-Spring Room in Zhangzhou's Banyue Mountain Area
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Japanese villa room (luxury king, tatami king or bathtub king, 3 options) — ¥298 (≈$41, was ¥588) · Breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child · Free use of the villa’s shared living room and kitchen · Valid October 22, 2026 – January 24, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry · Book by 23:59 the day before

A villa stay rather than a hotel room: Shanhaiguan sits among the villas of the Banyue Mountain hot-spring area in Changtai District, Zhangzhou — the hot-spring country between Xiamen and Zhangzhou city. The entry tier is a Japanese-style villa room with a choice of three layouts (luxury king bed, tatami king bed, or a room with a bathtub), and every booking gets free Wi-Fi, parking and use of the villa’s shared living room and kitchen — handy for families who want to cook or spread out beyond one room. Check-in is from 14:00, check-out by 12:00, and you show your booking voucher and ID at arrival.

item.title: Nanjing Suning Zhongshan Golf Hotel from ¥999 (≈$139): 52㎡ Garden Balcony Room + Kids' Castle Park, No Weekend Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, 52㎡ garden-view balcony room — ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,499) · Breakfast for 2 · Seasonal afternoon tea for 2 · First-round minibar free · 200㎡ castle-style indoor kids’ park included · Valid October 21, 2026 – March 31, 2027 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 20:00 the day before

A spacious, quiet base on Nanjing’s green east side: Suning Zhongshan Golf Hotel stands on Huanling Road in the Xuanwu District, by the Zhongshan (Purple Mountain) scenic area. The headline room is a generous 52㎡ with a balcony and a 1.81 m king bed, and the tier bundles breakfast for two, a seasonal two-person afternoon tea in the lobby lounge (14:00–17:00), a free first round from the minibar, and unlimited play in the hotel’s 200㎡ castle-style indoor kids’ park — the kind of setup where a rainy day still works out.

item.title: Suzhou Golden Riverside Hotel from ¥398 (≈$55): Garden Room + Hairy Crab Pair + Kids' Park on Taihu Lake
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, garden-view king/twin room — ¥398 (≈$55, was ¥599) · Breakfast for 2 · A pair of hairy crabs (processing fee waived) + ¥100 dining voucher · Kids’ park, kids’ cinema, games room and DIY baking included · Valid October 22 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 20:00 the day before

A Taihu Lake family stay with the season’s signature extra: Golden Riverside Hotel sits on Huantaihu Avenue in Suzhou’s Taihu Lake resort area, and the headline tier pairs a garden-view room with a pair of hairy crabs — autumn’s Suzhou delicacy, with the cooking fee waived — plus a ¥100 dining voucher. Children are well covered without leaving the hotel: the kids’ park, kids’ cinema, games room and DIY baking sessions are all included, and there’s an indoor heated pool and gym for adults. Breakfast is for two adults; children under 1.4 m eat free, older children pay the full ¥88 breakfast price.

item.title: Jiaxing Meihuazhou — 2 Nights from ¥469 (≈$66): Stay Inside a 4A Scenic Town, Golden Ginkgo Season
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights, comfort room + breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.4 m) — ¥469 (≈$66) (was ¥996) · 1 night, same room + breakfast + DIY tie-dye + 2 drinks — ¥336 (≈$47, was ¥538) · ⏰ valid through Feb 28, 2027 · Weekends at no surcharge · Book at least 3 days ahead (by 20:00) · Unreserved vouchers refundable

Meihuazhou is a national 4A scenic area in Fengqiao, Jiaxing — about 1.5 hours from Shanghai, Hangzhou and Suzhou — a 1,500-year-old water town whose land is split by waterways into five petal-like pieces, hence the name “Plum Blossom Isle.” November is ginkgo season here: the area’s two millennium-old ginkgo trees, both over 29 metres tall and standing across the river from each other for 1,250 years, turn gold, and locals call them the “love trees” joined by the Milky Way. Staying guests sleep inside the scenic area itself, in either Zitaoxuan (a Jiangnan water-town style inn) or Shuixicaotang (a Zen-themed inn built around the 24 solar terms), and can come and go from the scenic area as often as they like with their room card.

item.description: Deal price: 40㎡ superior room (in the scenic area), 1 night + breakfast for two + 2 scenic tickets + 1 hairy crab + indoor children’s park — ¥399 (≈$56) (was ¥599) · 45㎡ deluxe Misty-Rain Lake room + family set meal — ¥598 (≈$84, was ¥899) · 55㎡ executive lakeside courtyard family room + breakfast for three + petting feeding — ¥899 (≈$126, was ¥1,299) · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026 · Saturday surcharge ¥150 per room-night

item.description: Deal price: private hot-spring 3-bedroom villa, 1 night (mahjong room or KTV room) + afternoon tea + farm fishing + local gift — ¥578 (≈$81) (was ¥1,588) · Luxury villa, both mahjong and KTV rooms included — ¥678 (≈$95, was ¥1,788) · 2-night stay, same villa + unlimited private-pool soaking — ¥888 (≈$124, was ¥2,560) · ⏰ valid through Jan 24, 2027 · Reserve by 23:59 the day before · Unreserved vouchers refundable, auto-refund on expiry

item.description: Deal price: deluxe room, 1 night + breakfasts + gift package — ¥538 (≈$76) (was ¥1,128) · Seaview family room / seaview suite / family suite (interchangeable), 2 nights — ¥898 (≈$126, was ¥1,788) · Seaview room or family suite, 2 nights + kayaking or squash — ¥1,238 (≈$174, was ¥2,188) · 3 nights + wine or coffee set — ¥1,299 (≈$183, was ¥2,388) · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

item.title: Suzhou Tongli Lake Resort — Villa 2 Nights from ¥599 (≈$84)
item.description:
Deal price: villa twin room, 2 nights — ¥599 (≈$84) (was ¥699) · Phase-2 comfort / superior / garden room (pick one), 2 nights — ¥799 (≈$112, was ¥1,099) · Phase-2 lake room, 2 nights — ¥999 (≈$140, was ¥1,599) · Each tier: 1 room × 2 nights or 2 rooms × 1 night · ⏰ valid through Mar 31, 2027 · Weekends and New Year at no surcharge

Tongli Lake Resort sits on the shore of Tongli Lake in Suzhou’s Wujiang district, surrounded on three sides by water across about 60,000㎡ of Jiangnan gardens — white walls, grey tiles and tree-lined paths, with the lake on the doorstep. The resort’s 253 rooms run 40–47㎡ with bright floor-to-ceiling windows, and the deal adds daily breakfast for two (children under 1.2 m free), two servings of late-night congee per room-night, unlimited indoor and outdoor kids’ playgrounds, the petting zoo, and indoor heated pools for adults and children, plus the gym and table tennis.

item.description: Deal price: deluxe room, 1 night + 2 hot-spring entries + 2 breakfasts — ¥488 (≈$69) (was ¥1,699) · Family room, 1 night + 2 adults + 2 children hot-spring entries + breakfasts — ¥599 (≈$84, was ¥1,699) · Themed family room (pirate / princess / Native American, pick one), 1 night + 3 hot-spring entries + 3 breakfasts + piggy bank — ¥959 (≈$135, was ¥1,699) · ⏰ valid through Jan 31, 2027

item.title: Ningbo Xiangshan Banbianshan Guantang Resort — Seaside Stay + Seafood Dinner from ¥399 (≈$56)
item.description:
Deal price: 30–40㎡ Guantang room, 1 night + 2 breakfasts + hanfu experience + seafood dinner for two — ¥399 (≈$56) (was ¥699) · 2-night version + seafood noodles + hot spring tickets — ¥699 (≈$98, was ¥1,199) · Bookable Oct 29 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Banbianshan Guantang sits inside the Banbianshan seaside resort area in Xiangshan, Ningbo — a hotel designed around its coastal setting, with reef, fishing-boat and wave motifs woven through the lobby and rooms, and 126 rooms in total. The beach is a short walk from the room blocks, so sea views, sand play and paddling are right outside the door, and the hotel’s Jiangnan-courtyard corners, covered bridges and pavilions make for easy photo stops.
